title: Synthesis 8: the boundary that works is a slow exterior (ringless exterior-slow twins match the nematic fuel ring split for split); swim-divide is stuck on M
summary: Since c14's 16:40 synthesis: mwall gate work, the fuel-ring resolution test and c11's nematic no-repair are established; the FCH chemoton is down to SI and evoloop's H sweep did not replicate on 2 fresh seeds. Two shifts. First, a ringless twin with fuel slowed only outside the rods matches the self-made ring's whole division gain (32 vs 30 splits over 3 seeds, no ring 14), so walls should be scored against an exterior-only slow-D twin. Second, in active nematics swim-divide is stuck on motility, which more activity, stiffness or flow alignment do not give. Next: walls with a non-transport job, wet or polar active droplets for M, and damage tests on large bodies.
